Multi‑Trade Contractor in Atlanta, GA

If you need a single, accountable team to handle framing, roofing, plumbing, electrical, HVAC, drywall/paint, flooring, and exterior work, Build Heritage is the contractor you’ll want. We serve property managers, apartment communities, HOAs, brokers, and investors across metro Atlanta, and we provide a free, itemized quote within 48 hours.

Why Choose Build Heritage?

  • All‑in‑one expertise – Eight trades under one licensed and insured team, so you never have to juggle multiple subcontractors.
  • Transparent pricing – We deliver a detailed, itemized quote so you know exactly what you’re paying for.
  • Accountable leadership – One project manager keeps the schedule, budget, and quality on track.
  • Local focus – Our knowledge of Atlanta’s building codes and market conditions means smoother approvals and faster project completion.

What We Offer

| Service | Description | |---------|-------------| | Framing | Structural skeletons built to code. | | Roofing | Installation, repair, and maintenance of all roof types. | | Plumbing | Water supply, drainage, and fixture installation. | | Electrical | Wiring, panels, and lighting solutions. | | HVAC | Heating, ventilation, and air‑conditioning systems. | | Drywall/Paint | Interior finishes that protect and beautify. | | Flooring | Hardwood, tile, laminate, and more. | | Exterior | Siding, trim, and curb appeal enhancements. |

All work is performed by a single team, so communication is streamlined and accountability is clear.

How It Works

  1. Request a Quote – Fill out our quick online form; no account required.
  2. Get a Free Itemized Quote – We respond within 48 hours with a detailed estimate.
  3. Plan & Approve – Review the quote, make any adjustments, and approve the scope.
  4. Project Execution – Our project manager coordinates all trades, keeps you updated, and ensures quality.
  5. Completion & Review – We finish on time, on budget, and hand the project over with a final walkthrough.

Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Do you handle large apartment complexes? A: Yes, we have experience managing projects for multi‑unit residential properties, ensuring minimal disruption to tenants.

Q: Are you licensed and insured in Georgia? A: Absolutely. Build Heritage holds all necessary state licenses and comprehensive insurance coverage.

Q: How long does a typical project take? A: Project duration varies by scope, but our single‑team approach often shortens timelines compared to coordinating multiple subcontractors.

Next Step

Ready to streamline your construction or renovation? Request your free, itemized quote today.
